messages:
amanda_c: Hey folks — we need to schedule an after-action review for the outage earlier today (rwinf-512). Customer impact: a subset of Dedicated customers saw 5–10m tail latency spikes and a handful of 504s. Can someone host? Prefer whoever did triage.
ryan_s: I can host. Free tomorrow 10–11am PT or 4–5pm PT. I’ll prepare timeline + logs.
jessie_p: Thanks @ryan_s. 4pm PT works for me — that hits evening for EMEA but still doable. Support and infra should be included.
sre-bot: Incident INC-512 auto-summary: closed at 3281233000, duration ~45m. High CPU+KV cache churn detected. Actions auto-assigned where possible.
mike_t: I can attend 16:00 PT but prefer 09:00 PT. If it's at 4pm I’ll join remote/recording. :+1:
amanda_c: Ok, let’s aim for 16:00 PT (4pm). I’ll send a calendar invite with agenda: timeline, RCA hypotheses, short-term mitigations, long-term actions, owners. Will also add a Doodle if conflicts.
ryan_s: SGTM. I’ll add runbook snippets and the hotspot traces. Can someone grab the p99 chart and embed in the invite? cc @jessie_p
jessie_p: Pulling metrics now — snippet for pre-read: ```CPU: 95% on node-gpu-7 between 14:02–14:07; p99 latency +520ms; errors: 12x 504s clustered at 14:04```
amanda_c: Noted. Invite list: SRE, infra, support, a Dedicated account rep. @mike_t you’re action owner for the perf test follow-up.
mike_t: Yep — I’ll spin up a perf-run ticket and link it in the agenda. Ticket RW-7891.
ryan_s: One ask: include a canary rollback step in the short-term mitigations; I think the current runbook omits it.
amanda_c: Good call. I’ll add "rollback to model-v2a" and a quick checklist. Also pinging Product for customer context — @lina_p can you join at 4pm PT?
lina_p: I can make 4pm PT, will bring customer notes and any account threads.
amanda_c: Great — if anyone can’t make, please add notes to the calendar event or request the recording. I’ll send the invite + pre-read in ~15m and post the link here. Thanks all.
